title: Canaan (son of Ham)
summary: Son of Ham, cursed by Noah (Gen 9:25); father of Sidon, Heth and the Canaanite clans (Gen 10:15-18).
description: Son of Ham, cursed by Noah (Gen 9:25); father of Sidon, Heth and the Canaanite clans (Gen 10:15-18). Josephus (Antiquities I.6.2, Whiston): "Canaan, the fourth son of Ham, inhabited the country now called Judea, and called it from his own name Canaan."

birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 3)," Biblical Chronology 6:5 (May 1994), §8 "The Table of Nations", table "An Hypothetical Chronology for the Table of Nations"
birth.note: Jordan: "If we assume births every two years, and about 30 years between generations ... we can come up with an approximate series of dates" (hypothetical, not stated by Scripture).

open_questions: Place link is by name: OpenBible identifies the place named in later scripture (Deut.2.23, Gen.10.19, Gen.13.10, Gen.14.2, Gen.20.1), not the Gen 10 ancestor.
